verdict.rationale: Pandoc documents format direction on its homepage with arrow notation: ← for input-only (CSV, TSV, Excel), → for output-only (ICML, PDF engines) and ↔ for both (ipynb). It also ships --list-input-formats and --list-output-formats so a user can check support before converting. Missing for 10: an explicit pair matrix or statement that every input converts to every output, per-pair fidelity or limitation notes, and independent corroboration of the format lists.

support.subject: As a power user, the tool documents which input formats convert to which outputs, so I can check a pair before trying it

citations.quote: You can also use pandoc --list-input-formats and pandoc --list-output-formats to print lists of supported formats.
← CSV tables ← TSV tables ← Microsoft Excel spreadsheets
